company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration, enabling developers and engineers to create, test, manage, and distribute APIs at enterprise scale.
target_audience: Engineers and developers building, testing, and managing APIs

company_overview: Supabase provides an open-source backend platform built on PostgreSQL, offering authentication, real-time data, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings as a Firebase alternative. It enables developers and companies to launch and scale applications quickly with a fully managed Postgres database and integrated services.
target_audience: Developers and product teams building web or mobile applications, including startups and fast‑growing companies that need a scalable, open‑source backend.

company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for building, deploying, and managing AI-powered voice agents, offering rapid development, real‑time monitoring, and enterprise‑grade infrastructure. It targets enterprises and developers needing voice solutions for use cases like appointment scheduling, customer support, and lead qualification.
target_audience: Enterprises and developers building voice AI agents for customer support, appointment scheduling, lead qualification, and similar use cases.
